tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Raising of polythene bag sedlings in Mukve nursery at Puttur social forestry Range ange

itemList.description: Raising of 4x6 seedlings for transplanting into 8x12 PBS
Procurement of 4.6125 cum, Farm Yard Manure compost 4.6125 cum. of sand and 9.225  cum of Redearth. (18.45 cum, required for 8x12 minus 2.55 cum of transplanted 4x6 bag)
Mixing the ingredients, filling the polythene bags and arranging in rows after scraping the earth.
Transplanting of 4x6 size bagged seedlings into 8x12 size bags
Watering to the Polythene Bagged seedlings twice a day from 01.12.2026 to 31.03.2027 for 121 days
Weeding to the polythene bagged seedlings - 3 times
Shifting & grading the PBs seedlings - 2 times
Procurement of plant protection and growth promotion materials/compunds, their application, nursery pumpset fuel/maintenance/electricity bill of pumpset and other unforseen items and charges
